description: Source code for the EdgeRDD class in Apache Spark's GraphX module, defining an abstract class for edge RDDs with methods for mapping, reversing, joining, and creating edge RDDs from edges or partitions.

classes.name: EdgeRDD
classes.description: Abstract class extending RDD for graph edges with methods for transformation, reversal, joining, and storage level management.

methods.name: mapValues
methods.description: Transforms edge values while preserving structure.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses all edges in the RDD.

methods.name: innerJoin
methods.description: Joins this EdgeRDD with another, assuming same partitioning.

methods.name: withTargetStorageLevel
methods.description: Changes storage level of the EdgeRDD.

methods.name: fromEdges
methods.description: Creates an EdgeRDD from a set of edges.

methods.name: fromEdgePartitions
methods.description: Creates an EdgeRDD from existing edge partitions.
